title: Generate baseline
tagline: Design the ski's unweighted side profile: a camber pocket between the rocker contact points and fore and aft rockers out to the tips -- optionally shaped by the ski's own EI.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: A baseline is a handful of targets -- camber height, rocker lengths, tip heights -- that must meet in one smooth curve. Generate baseline builds it from those numbers, levels it on its rocker low points, and can shape the camber as the ski actually bends.
useWhen: Start a new ski's side profile
Shape the camber from the real EI
slides.caption: Test studio: NewTestBaseline, three edges (Z exaggerated 60 x).

points.head: Camber pocket
points.body: Pinned at FRCP and ARCP. With EI: the bending shape under a load at the mount. Without: a cubic peaking at the mount.

points.head: Rocker
points.body: A quadratic leaving FRCP tangent to the camber, ending FCP height below that tangent (measured normal to it).

points.head: Levelled
points.body: Rotated about the mount so both low points share Z; camber re-measured and corrected to 0.001 mm.

slides.title: The dialog
params: Curve per region (3 edges, one wire) or Single curve.
Between FCP and ACP: where camber height is measured and the load acts.
Camber height (0-15 mm), fore / aft rocker length, optional low-point distance, FCP / ACP height.
+ EI edges: camber = the ski's real bending shape.
The measurement sketch (as Analyze baseline draws).
A second wire: camber flattened, rockers rotated with it.

slides.title: Example: NewTestBaseline
slides.head: Camber 5 mm, rockers 200 / 200, FCP height 10, ACP height 6, Use EI profile on
slides.body: Camber exactly 5.0 mm at the mount (x = 0). The tips end 7.2 and 3.6 mm above the low points: tip height is measured from the camber tangent, not from Z = 0.

keys: The baseline wire (camber, fore rocker, aft rocker; or one spline).
messages: The requested rocker low point cannot be reached; the nearest reachable is used.
mount not between FCP and ACP

items.head: Two camber heights
items.body: Generate baseline sets it at the mount; Analyze baseline reports the largest perpendicular distance -- they differ with an off-centre mount.

items.head: No convergence notice
items.body: If 20 correction passes do not reach 0.001 mm, nothing is reported.
